title: Irrigation repair for a Langford retail centre

seo.title: Sample project: Langford retail irrigation | RNC
seo.description: Sample project: leak tracing and valve and drip repairs in a Langford retail centre's planters, done before store hours.

summary: Leak and coverage repairs across parking-island planters.
challenge: The property manager saw water running across the parking lot on watering mornings.
approach: We traced the leaks to a failed valve and damaged drip lines in the parking-island planters.
Repairs were done before store hours, and the property manager got a written record of each repair.
result: Leaks fixed, with a record of what was replaced.
